item.title: Diver imagery reveals Colombia’s new jelly set
item.description: Fragile comb jellies disintegrate when they are removed from the sea, but by analysing them by means of underwater photography and videography researchers have been able to identify new types off both Colombia’s Caribbean and Pacific coasts – including six species never before recorded in the country’s waters.
